scope.ddl_keys_and_columns: derived only; not copied into this registry
scope.coverage: selected product tables from registered separated DDL; excludes SQLite internals and runtime-created virtual/shadow tables
scope.python_binding_evidence: row_type names dedicated DDL-generated frozen row codecs; python preserves observed input/projection bindings; neither proves admission/semantic correctness
scope.external_reference_scope: catalogue-registered optional external references only; other cross-domain semantics remain unformalized

core.responsibility: Git identity, attributed immutable claims, allowed retained representations and receiver evidence.

context.responsibility: Service/source registrations, generalized resources, attributed relations/text and Context coverage evidence.

access.responsibility: Local connection configuration, locator bindings, scope controls and local approvals.

operational.responsibility: Request orchestration and required durable budgets/accounting/checkpoints; reconstructibility is scoped, not domain-wide.

search.responsibility: Rebuildable search projections, separate from authoritative Core/Context facts.

filesystem.responsibility: Independent historical filesystem metadata/digests and honest scan outcomes, with raw path identity.

worktrees.responsibility: Independent Git topology/worktree observations and explicitly optional qualified links.

gaps.detail: The retired normal Catalog3 format mixes Core/Context/Access and uses different Git object/ref keys. The ordinary CLI now composes separated stores; remaining legacy code/test retirement is explicitly tracked. Repository UUID identity already existed in both. Existing DBs are never converted or overwritten.

Every selected persistent class has a dedicated generated row_type. The separate python binding describes observed input/projection classes; null there means no such dedicated input class recorded, not missing SQL functionality or missing generated row type. Domain admission, serialization behavior and capability checks require their own regressions.

Filesystem Root is currently root_path within Scan; ScanResult and FileEntry are result/projection types. Do not invent a roots table to match an aggregate or value type. Decide whether independent Root identity is necessary only with its domain semantics.

WorktreeEntry remains a scoped DTO whose enclosing DiscoveryResult supplies observation identity. The dedicated WorktreeRow now explicitly carries observation_uuid plus root_path; adapters preserve the full key without rewriting the DTO into a raw row.

Context coverage scopes/claims/proofs are real selected tables even if absent from a website concept group. The web branch semantic-model (seven groups of responsibility domains) and older five-store model are derived explanations with different granularities, not canonical table/class maps; their update is independent and deferred.

Only existing catalogue-registered optional external references and DDL physical FKs are checked/rendered. Context/Core references, paired identity rules, operation preconditions, CHECK/trigger semantics, dynamic virtual tables and retained-instance validity are not fully formalized. Coverage success is not complete operation or semantic conformance.

roadmap.detail: Build on existing independent implementations for Core lifecycle including required recovery, Context reads, paired reads/recovery and Access. Assess remaining separated-format adapter/admission/backup/activation gaps against the module operation contract; do not claim these existing capabilities absent. Preserve Core INSERT-only/typed keys, ADR 0038 stop/preserve/typed salvage/fresh verified restore and paired validation. Carry ADR 0039 independent Filesystem/Worktrees raw paths, partial scans, optional qualified references, EFU and DB-free Local composition; those are outside OP-01..12. Fresh DB start needs no legacy conversion; never mutate/delete retained source DBs.

Assess and complete separated-format Operational request orchestration, Git acquisition with optional Access, Exchange and Search integration using existing APIs. Preserve actual cumulative work, durable reservations/checkpoints, package binding and honest loss behavior. Rebuild derivative Search without enlarging authority. Required recovery correctness remains part of foundations, not an optional late add-on.

Only after behavior/adapter tests and recovery prerequisites pass, switch ordinary initialization/CLI composition to fresh separated catalogs. Keep operation-scoped optional initialization: no command must initialize or open all seven DBs simply because the design has seven responsibility roles. This phase is not implemented here.

Remove normal-format factories/adapters and obsolete normal-only tests only after recording each affected test node and its concrete separated-format replacement for the same behavior, including corrupt-source stop, backup/restore, Exchange and accounting failures. Retire tests by obligation, not by coverage counts. No backward-compatibility adapter or old-data migration is required; no authorization to delete user DBs or historical evidence is created.
